details: US inflation for September is projected to reach 3.6% year-over-year, an increase from August's 3.4% and significantly above the Federal Reserve's 2% target. The official September Consumer Price Index (CPI) data is scheduled for release next Wednesday. Despite persistent inflation, money markets currently indicate only a 19% probability of a Fed interest rate hike on October 28th, though a quarter-point increase is fully priced in for December.
title: US Inflation Forecast Rises Ahead of CPI Release, Fed Rate Hike Odds Shift

details: The European Central Bank's (ECB) Governing Council accounts from its September 9-10 meeting, released on October 8, confirmed a unanimous 25-basis-point interest rate hike, effective September 16, 2026. The decision was driven by persistently high energy and food prices and a resilient euro area economy, with eurozone inflation jumping to 3.8% since September. Policymakers noted that higher long-term rates could significantly curb growth and inflation, influencing future policy decisions.
title: ECB Account Reveals Persistent Inflation Concerns and Rate Hike Justification

details: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) projects global economic growth at 3.3% for 2026 and 3.2% for 2027, a slight upward revision from its October 2025 World Economic Outlook. While global inflation is expected to decrease, US inflation is anticipated to decline more gradually. IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva identified the rapid rise of AI, persistently high energy prices, and record levels of public debt as key global economic shapers. The full October 2026 World Economic Outlook report is due for release on October 13th.
title: IMF Maintains Steady Global Growth Outlook Amid Inflation & Geopolitical Risks

details: Energy prices saw an uptick on Thursday following reports of intensified Iranian attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz. However, WTI crude oil prices slipped slightly on Friday to around $91 per barrel after President Trump indicated that the US would not launch new attacks on Iran before the midterm elections, also citing productive diplomatic discussions. Despite this fluctuation, overall oil and gas prices remain elevated, contributing to persistent global inflationary pressures.
title: Oil Prices Fluctuate Amid Middle East Tensions, Contributing to Inflation

details: US 10-year Treasury yields closed at 5.24% on October 9, 2026, contributing to a record demand for Treasury futures and options in September. While stabilization in bond markets has positively influenced equity sentiment, high and surging yields generally make traditional safe-haven assets more appealing, potentially diverting capital from riskier investments.
title: Demand for Treasury Futures Surges as Yields Remain Elevated
